tickets.subject: Proofpoint Essentials - Alert: Delivery blocked
tickets.description: Incident reported by Proofpoint Essentials (do-not-reply@proofpointessentials.com): Proofpoint Essentials - Alert: Delivery blocked. Requires IT investigation and verification.
tickets.resolution:
This ticket was raised by Redi to report a suspected phishing email.

I assigned the ticket to myself for review. During the investigation, I confirmed that Zoho is configured to send notifications to agents whenever a ticket is assigned. In this case, the ticket content contained suspicious links and content that matched spoofing/phishing indicators.

As a result, the Zoho notification email triggered Proofpoint's security policies and was blocked. The message received was a delivery-blocked notification generated by Proofpoint.

Proofpoint is functioning as expected by preventing the potentially risky content from being delivered. No further action is required from our side.

tickets.troubleshootingSteps: 1. Inspected email headers and links. 2. Verified Proofpoint Essentials policy. 3. Confirmed delivery quarantine.
